# Kenney Furniture Kit 2.0 — CC0

Author: Kenney, https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit
Original unmodified license: `License.txt`.
Source mirror: https://github.com/ETdoFresh/kenney.nl/tree/master/furniturekit_updated
Retrieved 2026-10-22. Individual source PNGs are unchanged.

`atlas.png`/`atlas.json` are trimmed/resized/padded derivatives generated with
`node scripts/build-furniture-atlas.cjs`. The live department renderer uses this
local atlas. No external runtime requests, paid license, or attribution obligation.
We retain the author's name and license for provenance regardless.

The OpenGameAsset.net catalog was reviewed at the user's suggestion, but its
source verification gate and unclear displayed licensing prevented using that
candidate. These CC0 files are not represented as downloads from that catalog.
